newsitem.title: USA: Dell notes Q2 not historically strong - DLJ.
newsitem.headline: Dell notes Q2 not historically strong - DLJ.

text.p: Dell Computer Corp is reminding analysts that second quarter is "not historically a strong one" and that it lacks specific demand drivers such as first quarter government sales, a Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette analyst said in a note to clients.

"We spoke with management and found the company remains confident about the pace of business and is comfortable with Street mean revenue estimates of $2.65 billion and $1.07 in earnings per share," said analyst Kevin McCarthy. He said Dell's shares have fallen recently on concerns about the quarter, which ends July 31. Dell was off 2-09/16 to 114-7/8.
